name: @pipedog/pocket-tts
description: Pocket TTS for pipedog: a port of Pipecat's PocketTTSService, running Kyutai's Pocket TTS locally on ONNX Runtime through @pipedog/onnx.

needs.all: onnxruntime-node (onnxruntime-web 1.30 can't read the graphs' empty state outputs) and a filesystem for the model cache: the model downloads on first use from Hugging Face (6-layer languages ~405 MB fp32, ~180 MB with quantize; french_24l ~1.3 GB; ~6 MB per voice).
needs.workerd: Not supported: the flow LM graph (76-1210 MB) and its 50 MB KV-cache state per step exceed Workers' memory and bundle limits.
